title: variantly — 13 more concepts (h–t)
question: Which of the 13 new worlds join the switcher?

declined.kept: layer history as state: concepts already viewed stay visible as a record

switcher: Twenty swatches overflow the current row of 7 chips, so the switcher should become a two-level picker grouped into families (Print & Paper: b, d, f, m, o; Material & Craft: a, n, p, r, t; Screen & Signal: c, h, i, j; Structure & Space: e, k, l, q, s; plus g). On desktop: a compact trigger showing the current concept's swatch, letter and name. It opens a popover grid, 4-5 columns with one family per column. Each tile is a 3-colour chip plus the name in that concept's own display face, so you preview the world before you click. Keep keyboard order a to t, roving arrow-key focus, and [ / ] (and the existing shortcuts) to step through all 20 without opening the grid. On mobile: the trigger becomes a bottom sheet with a horizontal snap-scroll strip of large tiles under family tabs, plus prev/next buttons at 44px or more. Persist the choice, deep-link with ?v=<id>, and offer a 'shuffle' tile so 20 concepts read as abundance, not a long menu.

options.label: Pixel Metropolis
options.lineage: eBoy pixoramas: isometric RGB pixel cities on one hard grid
options.thesis: Every variant is a building in one crisp isometric pixel city; the site is a block you can zoom into.
options.typography: Silkscreen for UI labels, Pixelify Sans for the title; title built as stacked isometric pixel blocks
options.background: isometric tile field (repeating-linear-gradient diamonds) with pixel cars sliding along 2:1 streets in steps(); 24s loop = one street length
options.letterLook: voxel bricks: flat-shaded MeshLambert cubes per letter-pixel, no smoothing, primary RGB faces
options.backdropScene: InstancedMesh voxel city block under an orthographic iso camera; cranes and blinking windows stepping on a 24s cycle
options.motion: stepped, frame-quantised (steps(n)), never eased; zoom in whole multiples
options.viewport: Title lockup centred over the background composition; switcher and CTA rendered as this world's own objects.
options.risk: Turns into retro-game nostalgia costume ('level up' copy) instead of a city grammar; pixel text is unreadable below 12px.

raised.raise: Only integer scales and one grid unit for everything, chrome included; no half pixels.
One hidden joke per block at deeper zoom, never in body copy.

options.label: Data Sublime
options.lineage: Ryoji Ikeda datamatics: barcode fields, sine lattices, pure black and white
options.thesis: Variants as frequencies: a strobing field of hairline bars where the design is the signal and everything else is data.
options.typography: Space Mono / JetBrains Mono only; title as a barcode wordmark: 'variantly' above its own bar encoding
options.background: vertical repeating-linear-gradient bar fields at three widths drifting at coprime speeds whose LCM is 24s; one SVG sine path scrolling via stroke-dashoffset
options.letterLook: binary: unlit MeshBasic pure white/black faces with hairline EdgesGeometry, no shading
options.backdropScene: LineSegments lattice forming a sine surface plus a point-cloud barcode wall; rare 1-frame invert
options.motion: strobe and snap; 1-frame cuts, otherwise dead still
options.viewport: Title lockup centred over the background composition; switcher and CTA rendered as this world's own objects.
options.risk: Collapses into TVA Terminal if any colour creeps in; strobing must respect reduced-motion and stay under 3 flashes/s.

raised.raise: Every number on screen is a real value (variant count, port, ms), never decorative noise.

options.label: Night Cockpit
options.lineage: the six-pack of a light aircraft at night: luminous gauges in a black panel
options.thesis: Your variants are six instruments you trust through cloud; one glowing needle tells you which to keep.
options.typography: B612 / B612 Mono (cockpit faces) for UI, title in Saira Stencil One with lume fill
options.background: grid of circular gauge faces (conic-gradient tick rings) with needles on 24s looped keyframes; attitude ball tilting
options.letterLook: lume and bezel: emissive mint numerals on satin black MeshStandard body with a thin metallic bevel
options.backdropScene: attitude-indicator sphere (sky/ground halves) gently banking inside a ring of tick marks
options.viewport: Title lockup centred over the background composition; switcher and CTA rendered as this world's own objects.
options.risk: Skeuomorphic dashboard cliche that reads as a fake analytics panel.

raised.raise: Each needle is honest: it points at real state (current variant, load progress).

options.label: Tension Rig
options.lineage: Kenneth Snelson tensegrity: carbon rods held by red cord
options.thesis: Opposed forces held in balance: the page is a rigid structure that visibly breathes, the way variants pull against the original.
options.typography: Big Shoulders Display for the title (letters as rods with cord crossings), Archivo Narrow for UI
options.background: SVG rods and red cords forming a tensegrity prism, nodes moving on a closed 24s breathing path
options.letterLook: strut and cord: anodised black metal rods with red TubeGeometry wrapped between glyph nodes
options.backdropScene: 3-strut tensegrity column (CylinderGeometry + red TubeGeometry) that inhales and lengthens on a sine
options.motion: slow inhale/exhale, tension-held; nothing ever falls
options.viewport: Title lockup centred over the background composition; switcher and CTA rendered as this world's own objects.
options.risk: Reads as a generic architecture-firm diagram; red on grey can look corporate.

raised.raise: One structural unit (rod length) scales all spacing, the way the pixel does.

options.label: Event Horizon
options.thesis: Choosing is a threshold: variants orbit a dark centre and the one you keep crosses the horizon.
options.typography: Unbounded for the title, warped around the ring on a curved text path; Syne for UI
options.background: concentric conic + radial gradient rings rotating at differing speeds (24s LCM) around a pure black disc, with a skewed duplicate ring for the lensed arc
options.letterLook: plasma: emissive orange-gold MeshPhysical with sheen, fading to black at glyph cores
options.backdropScene: RingGeometry disk with additive orbiting particles around a black sphere, top arc tilted for lensing
options.motion: slow orbit, time-dilated: outer rings fast, inner slow
options.viewport: Title lockup centred over the background composition; switcher and CTA rendered as this world's own objects.
options.risk: Space wallpaper; the glow drifts into AI-startup purple-orange cliche.

raised.raise: Total commitment to black: the void is true #000 and takes real area.

options.label: Cyanotype Plan
options.lineage: sun-printed cyanotypes and architects' diazo blueprints
options.thesis: Each variant is a sun-printed plan of your page: white line on Prussian blue, exposed, washed and pinned.
options.typography: Rubik Mono One for the title with construction lines and dimension arrows; IBM Plex Mono for labels
options.background: drafting grid (repeating-linear-gradient) with dimension lines drawing on via stroke-dashoffset and a T-square sweep; 24s
options.letterLook: blueprint enamel: deep blue matte with white emissive edge lines (wireframe overlay)
options.backdropScene: white wireframe architectural massing (EdgesGeometry) slowly orbiting in blue fog
options.motion: drafted: lines draw, then hold; measured easing
options.viewport: Title lockup centred over the background composition; switcher and CTA rendered as this world's own objects.
options.risk: Generic 'blueprint' tech trope; white-on-blue body copy is tiring to read.

raised.raise: Annotations are real: dimensions label actual layout widths.

options.label: Delft Tile
options.lineage: Delftware tin-glaze tiles and Portuguese azulejos
options.thesis: Variants as hand-painted tiles: a wall of cobalt-on-white squares, each telling one version of the story.
options.typography: Fraunces (soft, wonky) for the title in brushed cobalt with corner-ornament frames; Cormorant for UI
options.background: tile grid whose corner ornaments (radial-gradient quarter circles) join into continuous motifs; a tile-flip wave crosses the wall in 24s
options.letterLook: glazed ceramic: clearcoat white MeshPhysical with a cobalt-painted face map and slight wobble normals
options.backdropScene: curved wall of tiles flipping in a travelling wave
options.viewport: Title lockup centred over the background composition; switcher and CTA rendered as this world's own objects.
options.risk: Souvenir-shop kitsch; drifts toward Soft Clay if the glaze is too soft.

raised.raise: The tile is the only grid unit; everything snaps to it.

options.label: Herbarium Sheet
options.lineage: Victorian herbarium sheets: pressed specimens, gummed tape, archival labels
options.thesis: Each variant is a pressed specimen taped to acid-free card with its label: collected, named, compared.
options.typography: Playfair Display italic for the title with a typed accession label in Courier Prime
options.background: pressed-leaf silhouettes (clip-path shapes) swaying slightly, tape strips, and a slow light sweep across the card; 24s
options.letterLook: pressed paper: rough MeshStandard card with leaf-vein relief and taped corners
options.backdropScene: a few flat leaf planes drifting and turning as if under a lifting glass
options.viewport: Title lockup centred over the background composition; switcher and CTA rendered as this world's own objects.
options.risk: Wedding-stationery / cottagecore costume; may be too quiet for a tool site.

raised.raise: Labels carry real fields (variant id, date, model) in strict tabular form.

options.label: Urushi Lacquer
options.lineage: Japanese urushi lacquerware with maki-e gold
options.thesis: Deep layered black and vermilion lacquer: the variant you keep is polished until it reflects you.
options.typography: Shippori Mincho B1 for the title with a gold-dust stroke; Zen Kaku Gothic New for UI
options.background: layered vermilion/black bands with a slow specular streak (linear-gradient sweep) and drifting gold flecks; 24s
options.letterLook: lacquer: MeshPhysical clearcoat 1, roughness 0.05, black and vermilion, gold flake sparkle
options.backdropScene: a lacquer bowl reflecting an environment map, with a slow highlight orbit
options.viewport: Title lockup centred over the background composition; switcher and CTA rendered as this world's own objects.
options.risk: Orientalist pastiche; must avoid fake-Japanese copy and stay led by the material.

raised.raise: Restraint of means: two colours plus gold, nothing else.

options.label: Transit Wayfinding
options.lineage: Vignelli's NYC subway diagram and Kinneir/Calvert station signage
options.thesis: Every variant is a line on one map; you ride to a station and keep the stop you like.
options.typography: Overpass (Highway Gothic heir) for the title on a black sign band with coloured route bullets; Inter Tight for UI
options.background: 45/90-degree coloured lines (SVG paths) with train dots running along them via offset-path; 24s round trip
options.letterLook: enamel sign: glossy painted steel, white vinyl-cut letters, coloured disc bullets
options.backdropScene: 3D tube map: coloured TubeGeometry lines with small cars moving along the curves
options.viewport: Title lockup centred over the background composition; switcher and CTA rendered as this world's own objects.
options.risk: Overlaps Bauhaus primaries; a generic 'map metaphor'.

raised.raise: Stations are real: each stop is an actual variant or step.

options.label: Stained Glass
options.thesis: Variants as panes in one window; light passes through the one you choose.
options.typography: Cinzel Decorative for the title as leaded glyphs (thick black came around jewel fills); Alegreya for UI
options.background: field of clip-path polygon panes; a light band sweeps across, changing pane brightness; 24s
options.letterLook: glass: MeshPhysical transmission 0.9 with thickness, jewel tints and a black came outline
options.backdropScene: rotating rose-window disc of transparent coloured shards with a moving light
options.motion: slow luminous sweep, like the sun moving
options.viewport: Title lockup centred over the background composition; switcher and CTA rendered as this world's own objects.
options.risk: Ecclesiastical heaviness; transmission materials cost a lot of GPU.

raised.raise: Came lines share one stroke width everywhere, UI borders included.

options.label: Survey Contour
options.thesis: Variants as terrain: contour lines show how far each one climbs from the original.
options.typography: Barlow Condensed for the title as raised terrain with contours following the letterforms; Spectral for text
options.background: nested contour rings (repeating-radial-gradient) offset into hills, with a survey line and pin marching across; 24s
options.letterLook: terraced relief: one extruded layer per contour, sand-to-green banding
options.backdropScene: PlaneGeometry heightfield with contour-line shading in a slow flyover
options.viewport: Title lockup centred over the background composition; switcher and CTA rendered as this world's own objects.
options.risk: Generic hiking app; contour noise can muddy text contrast.

raised.raise: Spot heights are true numbers (e.g. diff size per variant).

options.label: Terrazzo Floor
options.lineage: Venetian terrazzo and Memphis-era terrazzo laminates
options.thesis: Variants as chips set in one poured floor; polishing reveals the composition.
options.typography: Bricolage Grotesque for the title with a chip-flecked fill; DM Serif Display for accents
options.background: scattered clip-path chips drifting in place, plus a polish highlight sweep; 24s
options.letterLook: polished stone: MeshPhysical roughness 0.25 matrix with embedded chip colours
options.backdropScene: instanced flat chips tumbling slowly above a polished plane
options.viewport: Title lockup centred over the background composition; switcher and CTA rendered as this world's own objects.

raised.raise: Brass strips impose structure: a strict division grid under the play.
